name: room
text: Room opened — goal: accessibility: Make EXCAVA usable by EVERYONE — contrast, mobile/touch, reduced-motion, keyboard nav, scr

name: Ramp
text: Adopt a 3px focus ring at 4.5:1 contrast with a 1px outer glow at 7:1 contrast. This balances visibility for low-vision users with subtle design, avoiding the harshness of a 7:1 ring alone. The glow ensures touch targets remain clear on mobile, where precision is harder. Trade-off: the glow adds slight visual noise, but it’s necessary for touch users who rely on focus indicators.

name: Reader
text: The 3px ring at 4.5:1 risks disappearing entirely on busy backgrounds or when users toggle reduced motion. A 4px ring at 7:1 contrast is the safer choice—it meets WCAG for low-vision users without relying on glow effects. Settle it with a live contrast test on varied backgrounds and motion settings.

name: Ramp
text:
Adopt a 4px focus ring at 7:1 contrast with no glow. This guarantees visibility for low-vision users across all backgrounds and respects reduced-motion preferences. The trade-off is a slightly bolder ring that some may find less subtle, but it removes dependency on glow effects that can fail on busy screens.

name: Reader
text: A 4px ring at 7:1 contrast still fails on patterned or high-contrast backgrounds where the ring blends into edges. Test a 3px ring at 7:1 with a 2px outer glow at 4.5:1 instead—this keeps the ring sharp for low-vision users while the glow handles busy backgrounds. Settle it by measuring visibility on 10 varied backgrounds with both reduced motion on and off.
